purpose: Development pilot on four previously observed failures with manually annotated repair regions. Human judgments are descriptive and unblinded.

cases.name: striped_shorts
cases.defect: Two invented trouser legs below the original shorts.
cases.prompt: Continuous matte warm brown textured studio backdrop, fine even grain, flat seamless surface, empty background.
cases.negative_prompt: clothing, pants, fabric folds, stripes, foreground object, extra objects

cases.name: printed_vest
cases.defect: The product print leaks across most of the generated background.
cases.prompt: Plain ivory seamless photographic backdrop, soft diffuse lighting, flat smooth empty studio background.
cases.negative_prompt: floral pattern, clothes, coat hanger, busy texture, foreground object, extra objects

cases.name: running_shoe
cases.defect: A tall white extension above the original shoe opening.
cases.prompt: Continuous matte burnt orange studio wall with fine grain, uniform warm reddish brown backdrop, empty surface.
cases.negative_prompt: shoes, shoe collar, white objects, lettering, extra objects

cases.name: striped_cup
cases.defect: The model adds a handle to a cup that has no handle.
cases.prompt: Continuous warm walnut tabletop with fine horizontal wood grain and even warm lighting, empty clean surface.
cases.negative_prompt: cup handle, ceramics, extra objects, foreground objects
